title: Enlarge the capacitor plates
hook: Change plate area and predict capacitance.
misconception: capacitance stays fixed when plate area doubles.
objective: Apply C = εA/d to compare capacitance when plate area changes, under the stated assumptions.

claims.text: With ideal parallel plates with fixed separation and dielectric permittivity ignoring edge effects, C = εA/d. When plate area doubles, capacitance becomes 2 times its original value.
claims.source: Idealized model C = εA/d; scaling exponent 1. Physics and assumptions await independent review.

recall.question: Consider ideal parallel plates with fixed separation and dielectric permittivity ignoring edge effects, with a nonzero initial result. If plate area triples from a positive value, what is the multiplier on capacitance?
recall.why: Apply C = εA/d under the same assumptions: the multiplier is 3.
